description: This file defines the JavelinGuardrail class, a custom guardrail implementation for integrating with the Javelin API within a larger system. It includes methods for calling the API, handling responses, and pre-call hooks to evaluate requests against guardrail policies.

classes.name: JavelinGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail class that interfaces with the Javelin API to evaluate requests and enforce guardrail policies.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JavelinGuardrail with configuration parameters and setting up the HTTP client.

methods.name: call_javelin_guard
methods.description: Makes an asynchronous API call to the Javelin service with the provided request data and processes the response.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-processing hook that evaluates request messages against guardrail policies and potentially blocks requests.

methods.name: get_config_model
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for the Javelin guardrail.
